title: In A Violent Nature
review: The actors in the group seem way to old to be behaving like this. They're written like teens. Why would they go to bed when there's so much wood in the fire? They put it out with a tablespoon of beer. Is this meant to be some joke about how campers behave in slasher horrors? As the film progress it becomes a surprisingly abstract take on the {Friday the 13th} formula, with bold camerawork and jump cuts. It assumes you understand tropes already and cuts straight to the good stuff. It's strange to think a sequel is in production. Along with {Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma}, I guess filmmakers are more interested in deconstructing the slasher genre than embracing it earnestly now.
spoilers: It doesn't bond you with each of the characters very well, and so the low-key final girl ending doesn't work on an emotional level. But it did leave me satisfied.
